newsitem.title: USA: February US aluminum orders remain strong- Spector.
newsitem.headline: February US aluminum orders remain strong- Spector.

text.p: Aluminum orders in the United States in February rose 10.4 percent above January's level, indicating an expanding economy and end-users with too little inventory after last year's destocking, industry analyst Stewart Spector said.
"As a result, it now appears likely that end-users could maintain a high booking rate for a while longer," Spector said.
On a seasonally adjusted basis, February bookings averaged 67.8 million lbs a day, compared to 58.3 million lbs in February 1996 and 61.4 million in January.

Non-can sheet bookings rose nearly 27 percent in February compared to the same month in 1996, but can sheet releases schedules fell 9.8 percent from a year ago, though they are up 3.8 percent year-to-date, Spector said.
